title: Design Patterns Introduction
intro: Design patterns (fresher level) introduces the GoF patterns a junior should know. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the patterns overview (what patterns are, why they exist), then the creational patterns (singleton, factory, builder), then structural (decorator) and behavioral (observer, strategy). It closes with when-to-use-patterns — the judgment tier that stops a fresher from pattern-spamming.
